global: This shoyu ramen boasts a rich, amber broth, topped with tender chashu, crisp menma, and vibrant green onions. A pink naruto fish cake sits center, all nestled in a white bowl on a dark wooden tray, under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Dark wooden tray with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections on its smooth, polished surface.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with delicate green floral pattern, smooth glossy surface, and slightly raised rim.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth with noodles, green onions, spinach, and a pink flower-shaped garnish, glossy and rich in color.
regions.spoon: A glossy red spoon with smooth, curved surface and slightly flared bowl shape.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is browned, tender-looking, and slightly curled, with visible fat marbling and a glossy surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, glossy, with layered, slightly curved segments and visible fibrous texture.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: white, spiral-shaped, with pink swirl center and scalloped edges, smooth surface.
